survey: A tall orange school locker on four short stubby feet stands on a wooden floor against a purple wall, turned three-quarters toward the camera with its left side panel visible. The left side panel has two groups of three horizontal vent louvres. The cabinet is an open box with a front frame. Inside, a shelf spans the full width, with a stack of books lying flat and three books standing upright on it. Below the shelf, a grey hanging rod runs between the two side walls, with a round end cap at the right wall. On the floor of the locker sit a pair of blue sneakers, and a basketball rests on and behind them, held by the shoes and the back wall. The door is hinged on the cabinet's right front edge and has swung open outward, so it faces the viewer almost flat. It is about the same size as the opening and carries two groups of vent louvres. Its keyhole latch sits near its free (right) edge, away from the hinge side, which is where a latch belongs. The hinges themselves are not drawn, which is an acceptable simplification.
